body.title: Runbook — seeding an Amplience hub
body.description: How a fresh Amplience CMS hub comes to carry the Amplience Frontend Starter content model and starter content. Everything the hub needs lives in this repo — settings, schemas, content types and extensions in `packages/hub-management/`, starter content in `packages/content/fixtures/` (the same files the mock client serves, so the hub and local dev never drift).
